claims: Continue mechanical ventilation with current settings (MMV/PSV/AutoFlow, PEEP 5, FiO2 40%, PSV 5) and monitor ventilator parameters, tidal volumes, and airway pressures.
Monitor arterial blood pressure and heart rate closely given recent hypotension (systolic ~100 mmHg) and ongoing nicardipine infusion; titrate vasoactive medications as needed.
Monitor intracranial pressure and cerebral perfusion pressure hourly, maintaining CPP above 60 mmHg and ICP below 20 mmHg.
Continue sedation with propofol and morphine, targeting Richmond-RAS of 0 (alert and calm) as documented, and reassess sedation level regularly.
Replete potassium given serum potassium 3.4 mEq/L; administer prescribed oral potassium chloride replacement and recheck potassium level.
Monitor serum ionized calcium (1.06–1.11 mmol/L) and consider calcium supplementation if clinically indicated.
Perform regular oral care and subglottal suctioning to prevent ventilator-associated pneumonia.
Implement fall precautions and pressure ulcer prevention given Braden score indicating risk and history of falls; maintain bed rest with repositioning.
Monitor blood glucose (finger stick 130–137 mg/dL) and continue glucose monitoring per protocol.
Obtain repeat arterial blood gas and electrolyte panel to reassess acid-base status, oxygenation, and electrolytes.
